assertions.name: does-not-cite-R510
assertions.evidence: The answer refuses to use R510 as a citation. It says "there is no rule R510 anywhere in it" (the V1 manual) and "'R510' in Team Update 00 is a typo", and tells the team to "cite **R501** when talking to an inspector." That meets the "doesn't exist in V1" branch of the assertion. The corpus agrees: rules.py lookup R510 --season biobuzz-2026-27 returns found:false with the message "R510 is not in the biobuzz-2026-27 manual".

assertions.name: cites-R501-table
assertions.evidence: The answer's content is right. It cites R501 in Section 12.5 and "Table 12-1 includes the row 'WATTOS Stingray 12V DC — WDM12'", which matches row 71-72 of table-12-1.json. The grounding requirement is not met, though. The assertion requires Table 12-1 to be read by pointer from manual-tables/biobuzz-2026-27/table-12-1.json. files_read lists only scratchpad manual.txt and tu00.txt, and scripts_run shows pdftotext and grep on a web-fetched PDF. The table JSON was never read, and neither was the R501 [[TABLE:12-1]] pointer. With no partial credit, this fails.
